---
pagetitle: "{{PAGETITLE}}"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    toc: false
    section_divs: false
    anchor_sections: false
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    md_extensions: "+fenced_divs+header_attributes+bracketed_spans"
---

<style>
  /* The checklist report (report_type("checklist")): every check of every
     module sorted into to fix, to check, decide by hand, for information,
     fine and not applicable. Colours and font are those of metacheck's
     website on SURF Research Cloud (its site.css): the logo's green and a
     light grey, and Cabin (SIL Open Font License, app/www/fonts/), embedded
     so the report stays one file that contacts no other site. Light only,
     like the website: a reader's dark setting does not change it. */
  @font-face {
    font-family: "Cabin";
    src: url("{{FONT_DATA_URI}}") format("truetype");
    font-weight: 400 700;
    font-stretch: 75% 100%;
    font-style: normal;
  }
  :root {
    color-scheme: light;
    --green: #2F6F1C;
    --green-dark: #1E4A10;
    --green-tint: #E3ECDF;
    --bg: #E9E8E5;
    --card: #F4F3F1;
    --line: #CFCDC8;
    --text: #262624;
    --muted: #5E5C58;
    --fix: #9B2C1F;
    --fix-tint: #F6E3DF;
    --improve: #7A4F00;
    --improve-tint: #F4E7C9;
    --improve-line: #C08A1E;
    --decide: #2C5577;
    --decide-tint: #DFE8EF;
    --na-tint: #E4E2DE;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { background: var(--bg); }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: "Cabin", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  a { color: var(--green); text-underline-offset: 2px; }
  a:hover { color: var(--green-dark); }
  code, pre { font-family: "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.84em; }
  code { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 4px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  pre { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 12px; overflow: auto; }
  pre code { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font-size: 1em; }

  /* title, as the website's masthead */
  .masthead { text-align: center; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px 0; }
  .logos { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 28px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .logos img { height: 64px; width: auto; }
  .masthead h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }
  .masthead .subtitle { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .masthead .meta { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-bottom: 16px; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--muted);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--green); }

  .mc-main { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 16px 48px; }
  .mc-intro { margin: 22px 0 18px; }

  /* the number of checks per result */
  .counts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin: 22px 0 32px; }
  .count { display: block; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 4px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--text); }
  a.count:hover { color: var(--text); background: #fff; }
  .count b { display: block; font-size: 1.9rem; line-height: 1.1; }
  .count span { font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .count.fix { border-top-color: var(--fix); } .count.fix b { color: var(--fix); }
  .count.improve { border-top-color: var(--improve-line); } .count.improve b { color: var(--improve); }
  .count.decide { border-top-color: var(--decide); } .count.decide b { color: var(--decide); }
  .count.fine { border-top-color: var(--green); } .count.fine b { color: var(--green); }
  .count.zero { opacity: 0.55; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .counts { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

  h2 { font-size: 1.35rem; margin: 36px 0 12px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  h2 .n { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; }

  /* one block per check that needs work */
  .check { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 5px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px 18px 12px; margin: 0 0 14px; }
  .check.fix { border-left-color: var(--fix); }
  .check.improve { border-left-color: var(--improve-line); }
  .check.decide { border-left-color: var(--decide); }
  .check-head p { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px 10px; margin: 0 0 10px; }
  .check-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.12rem; }
  .where { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted); margin-left: auto; }
  .tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; line-height: 1.6;
    text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 3px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .tag.fix { color: var(--fix); background: var(--fix-tint); }
  .tag.improve { color: var(--improve); background: var(--improve-tint); }
  .tag.decide { color: var(--decide); background: var(--decide-tint); }
  .tag.fine { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-tint); }
  .tag.info, .tag.na { color: var(--muted); background: var(--na-tint); }

  .rows { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8.5em minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 6px 14px; }
  .rows > .label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--muted); padding-top: 1px; }
  .rows > .text { min-width: 0; }
  .rows > .text.todo { font-weight: 600; }
  .rows p { margin: 0 0 4px; }
  .rows ul, .rows ol { margin: 0 0 4px; padding-left: 1.1em; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .rows { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px; }
    .rows > .label { padding-top: 6px; }
  }

  details { margin-top: 10px; }
  details > summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  details > summary:hover { color: var(--green-dark); }
  details[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .fold { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 12px; overflow-x: auto; }
  .fold > p:first-child { margin-top: 0; }

  table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 0.88rem; }
  th { text-align: left; background: var(--green-tint); color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; }
  th, td { padding: 5px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
  table strong { color: var(--fix); }

  /* the checks that passed, did not apply, or are for information */
  .done { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; }
  .done-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.5em 15em minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 4px 12px;
    padding: 8px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .done-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .done-row > div { min-width: 0; }
  .done-row .tag { justify-self: start; align-self: start; margin-top: 2px; }
  .done-row .t { font-weight: 600; }
  .done-row .d { color: var(--muted); }
  .done-row p { margin: 0 0 4px; }
  @media (max-width: 720px) { .done-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }

  .more > details { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 14px; margin: 0 0 10px; }
  .more > details > summary { font-size: 1rem; }

  footer { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 16px 40px; border-top: 1px solid var(--green);
    text-align: center; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--muted); }

  @media print {
    html, body { background: #fff; }
    .check, .done-row, .count { break-inside: avoid; }
  }
</style>

<header class="masthead"><div class="logos">{{LOGOS}}</div><h1>{{TITLE}}</h1><p class="subtitle">{{SUBTITLE}}</p><p class="meta">{{META}}</p></header>
